proposals.before: Jia Yi's argument influenced symbolic imperial plowing to promote agriculture.
proposals.after: Thereupon the emperor was moved by Jia Yi's words, first opened the imperial plow-fields, and personally plowed to encourage the people.
proposals.reason: Chinese 上感誼言，始開籍田，躬耕 makes the emperor the agent who was moved and personally plowed; the idiomatic paraphrase erases that agency.

proposals.before: The throne accepted this advice and granted a substantial tax reduction.
proposals.after: The emperor again followed his words and issued an edict remitting half of the people's rent and tax in the twelfth year.
proposals.reason: Chinese 下詔賜民十二年租稅之半 specifies a year-12 half remission; the idiomatic 'substantial tax reduction' drops that dating detail.

proposals.before: Thirteen years later, in Jing year two, people were ordered to pay half field rent, taxing one in thirty.
proposals.after: Thirteen years later, in Emperor Jing's second year, people were ordered to pay half field rent, taxing one in thirty.
proposals.reason: Literal 'Jing year two' is telegraphic and obscures that 孝景二年 is Emperor Jing's second year.

proposals.before: Late in reign, Emperor Wu signaled policy reversal by honoring 'enrich the people' governance.
proposals.after: Late in Emperor Wu's reign, he regretted the campaigns and then enfeoffed the Chancellor as Marquis of Enriching the People.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic invents a vague policy gloss and omits the named enfeoffment of the Chancellor as 富民侯 present in the Chinese.

proposals.before: Zhao Guo was appointed to implement grain-oriented agrarian reform.
proposals.after: He appointed Zhao Guo as Commandant for Grain Collection.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic replaces the concrete office appointment 搜粟都尉 with an invented reform paraphrase.

proposals.before: Where draft animals were scarce, officials adapted by introducing human-drawn plows.
proposals.after: Some people suffered from too few oxen and had no way to hurry cultivation, so Pingdu magistrate Guang taught Guo human-drawn plowing.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic omits the named magistrate Guang and Zhao Guo that the Chinese identifies as teacher and learner.

proposals.before: The adaptation was institutionalized through cooperative labor-pull arrangements.
proposals.after: Guo recommended Guang as assistant and taught the people to hire one another to pull plows.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic erases the named recommendation of Guang by Guo and the cooperative plow-pulling instruction.

proposals.before: “Then Grand Agriculture vice-director Geng Shouchang, skilled in calculation and discussing utility, favored by the emperor, memorialized in Wufeng period:
proposals.after: Then Grand Agriculture vice-director Geng Shouchang, skilled in calculation and discussing utility, favored by the emperor, memorialized in the Wufeng period:
proposals.reason: Idiomatic begins with a stray leading quotation mark not warranted by the Chinese.

proposals.before: “Then Grand Agriculture vice-director Geng Shouchang, skilled in calculation and discussing utility, favored by the emperor, memorialized in Wufeng period:
proposals.after: Then Grand Agriculture vice-director Geng Shouchang, skilled in calculation and discussing utility, favored by the emperor, memorialized in the Wufeng period:
proposals.reason: Literal likewise begins with a stray leading quotation mark.

proposals.before: He claimed direct state extraction had previously reduced fish supply, reversed when access returned to private fishers.
proposals.after: Elders all say that in Emperor Wu's time, when the county offices themselves fished, sea fish did not appear; later, when fishing was returned to the people, the fish then appeared.
proposals.reason: Idiomatic drops the explicit Emperor Wu time reference and the elders' report structure present in the Chinese.

decisions.reason: 上感誼言，始開籍田，躬耕以勸百姓 makes the emperor the agent who was moved, opened the plow-fields, and personally plowed; the prior idiomatic erases that agency and invents 'symbolic' plowing.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 於是上感誼言，始開籍田，躬耕以勸百姓

decisions.reason: 下詔賜民十二年租稅之半 specifies an edict remitting half the people's rent-tax in year twelve; 'substantial tax reduction' drops both the half measure and the year.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 乃下詔賜民十二年租稅之半

decisions.reason: Literal 'Jing year two' already renders 孝景二年 accurately in telegraphic form; expanding to 'Emperor Jing's second year' is stylistic clarity, not correction of a semantic or naming error.
悔征伐之事，乃封丞相為富民侯 states regret for the campaigns and the chancellor's enfeoffment as Marquis of Enriching the People; the prior idiomatic invents a vague policy gloss and omits that enfeoffment.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 悔征伐之事，乃封丞相為富民侯

decisions.reason: 以趙過為搜粟都尉 is a concrete office appointment as Commandant for Grain Collection; the prior idiomatic invents a reform paraphrase and drops the title.
平都令光教過以人輓犁 names Pingdu magistrate Guang teaching Guo human-drawn plowing; the prior idiomatic erases both persons for an anonymous official adaptation.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 平都令光教過以人輓犁

decisions.reason: 過奏光以為丞，教民相與庸輓犁 has Guo recommend Guang as assistant and teach mutual hired plow-pulling; the prior idiomatic erases the named recommendation.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 過奏光以為丞，教民相與庸輓犁

decisions.reason: The Chinese opens with narrative 時…五鳳中奏言：「 before the quoted memorial; a leading English quotation mark on this framing sentence is unwarranted and should be removed.
Same framing sentence as the idiomatic: 奏言：「 begins the quote after this clause, so the literal should not open with a stray leading quotation mark.
長老皆言武帝時縣官嘗自漁…後復予民，魚乃出 is elders' report dated to Emperor Wu's time about county offices fishing then restoring fishing to the people; the prior idiomatic drops that attribution and dating.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 長老皆言武帝時縣官嘗自漁，海魚不出，後復予民，魚乃出
